newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Treasury says Philip Anderson to head DMO.
newsitem.headline: NZ Treasury says Philip Anderson to head DMO.

text.p: Treasury said on Thursday Philip Anderson had been appointed to head the New Zealand Debt Management Office.
He replaces Graeme Wheeler who is resigning to take up a directorship in the World Bank's Treasury Department in Washington.
Anderson has headed the DMO's London office for the past four years and was previously acting head of the DMO's portfolio management for two years.
The DMO is merging with Treasury's Commerical and Financial branch to create a new branch with policy and operational responsibility for both sides of the government's balance sheet.
